title: Learning after Execution with Action-Specific Credit
abstract: arXiv:2610.14573v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Execution is often used as terminal feedback: it scores a generated program, but the resulting state is not used for another learning action. Learning after execution instead uses the execution result as an intermediate state that supports an additional learning interaction for the same policy. This creates a credit-assignment problem because the two actions share the same final objective but play different roles in the trajectory. Accordingly, action-specific credit assigns the initial action credit from the final trajectory outcome and the corrective action credit for improvement over the intermediate state. Image-to-TikZ serves as an executable visual testbed for this setting. On 945 held-out examples, learning after execution strengthens the shared policy under single-call inference and also produces a post-execution corrective capability. Single-call render success reaches 92.70\%, compared with 88.25\% for continued single-stage GR

translated_title: 基于动作特定信用分配的执行后学习
translated_abstract: 执行通常被用作终端反馈：它对生成的程序进行评分，但由此产生的状态不会被用于另一次学习动作。执行后学习则将执行结果作为中间状态，用以支持同一策略的额外学习交互。这带来了一个信用分配问题，因为这两个动作共享相同的最终目标，却在轨迹中扮演不同的角色。为此，动作特定信用分配将初始动作的信用归因于最终轨迹结果，而将纠正动作的信用归因于相对于中间状态的改进。图像到TikZ（Image-to-TikZ）任务作为该设置的可执行视觉测试平台。在945个留出示例上，执行后学习在单次调用推理下强化了共享策略，同时还产生了执行后的纠正能力。单次调用渲染成功率达到92.70%，而持续单阶段GRPO为88.25%。
tldr: 提出“执行后学习”框架与动作特定信用分配方法，将执行结果作为中间状态进行二次学习，在图像到TikZ任务上将单次调用渲染成功率提升至92.70%，并赋予模型执行后的纠正能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes "learning after execution" with action-specific credit assignment, treating execution results as intermediate states for an additional learning interaction, which raises single-call render success on Image-to-TikZ to 92.70% (vs. 88.25% for continued single-stage GRPO) and enables post-execution corrective capability.
